verdict_reason: The allOf false-schema handling works, but buildNode's extra false guard is unreachable and the allOf comments no longer describe the merge.

todos.issue: buildNode's new 'if (propSchema === false) continue;' is not reached. The only false property schema in schemas/profiles is gbn-ag-v1 exchangedDocument.properties.issuer, and exchangedDocument is merged with the core ExchangedDocument through the allOf branch in flatten(), whose new 'v === false' branch (line 144) already deletes it. No test fails if line 273 is removed. House rule: build only what this change makes reachable.
todos.fix: Must: every false-schema guard the walker carries is reached by a profile in this repo and fails a test when removed. One way: delete line 273.

todos.issue: The allOf comment (lines 133-137) says 'When two branches contribute a property with the same key, wrap them together'; after this change a branch contributing false removes the property instead, so the comment no longer describes the lines below it. The function's header comment (lines 66-71) likewise says 'the later one wins on scalar conflicts' and describes 'downstream callers'. Other comments in the file restate code ('// Recurse into properties' 270, '// Recurse into items' 285) or carry rationale ('Last-wins would silently drop...' 137, 162-164, 176-178), which house rules put in docs/.
todos.fix: Must: no comment in schema-walker.js is untrue of its lines, restates the code or carries rationale; the allOf merge reads from names. One way: extract the per-property merge into a named helper such as mergeBranchProperty(out, key, schema, excludedProperties), delete the stale and restating comments, and move the allOf-merge rationale to the repo's docs.
